Admin configuration for the news_api app.

class news_api.admin.CustomUserAdmin(model, admin_site)[source]

Bases: UserAdmin

Custom admin interface for the User model.

Extends Django’s default UserAdmin to include additional fields for managing user roles (Reader, Journalist, Editor) and subscriptions directly from the admin interface.

Parameters:

fieldsets (tuple) – Tuple of fieldset configurations for the admin form

Returns:

Customized admin interface for User model

Return type:

django.contrib.admin.ModelAdmin

class news_api.models.Article(*args, **kwargs)[source]

Bases: Model

Model representing a news article or newsletter.

Parameters:

  • content_type (str) – Type of content (article or newsletter).

  • title (str) – Title of the article.

  • content (str) – Body of the article.

  • author (User) – Foreign key to the User model for the author.

  • publisher (Publisher) – Foreign key to the Publisher model.

  • published_at (datetime) – Date and time when the article was published.

  • is_approved (bool) – Boolean indicating if the article is approved by an editor.

news_api.permissions module

Permissions for the news API.

class news_api.permissions.IsAuthorOrReadOnly[source]

Bases: BasePermission

Permission class for object-level access control.

Allows read-only access to everyone (GET, HEAD, OPTIONS requests). Write access (PUT, PATCH, DELETE) is restricted to the article author.

Parameters:

  • request (rest_framework.request.Request) – The incoming HTTP request object

  • view (rest_framework.views.APIView) – The view being accessed

  • obj (news_api.models.Article) – The object being accessed

Returns:

True if user has permission, False otherwise

Return type:

bool

has_object_permission(request, view, obj)[source]

Check if the user can access the specific object.

Safe methods (GET, HEAD, OPTIONS) are allowed for everyone. Write methods require the user to be the article author.

Parameters:

  • request (rest_framework.request.Request) – The incoming HTTP request object

  • view (rest_framework.views.APIView) – The view being accessed

  • obj (news_api.models.Article) – The article object being accessed

Returns:

True if read-only or user is the author

Return type:

bool
